messages:
Sara M.: Heads-up — I sketched a small follow-up to the warmup RFC about making per-layer cold-start scores explicit so the coordinator can make better decisions across tenants.
Liam: SG. Can you paste the scoring idea?
Sara M.: TL;DR: instead of a single priority number per shard, we compute a per-layer cold_start_score = alpha * expected_access_rate + beta * memory_pressure_factor + gamma * recompute_penalty. Coordinator sums layer scores to pick top-K layers to prefetch under budget.
Dmitri: That sounds reasonable. The big tradeoff is telemetry overhead and the extra RPCs from loaders to report layer stats.
Meera: Agreed. Also need to define stable surface between loader and coordinator. We shouldn't force loaders to know about tenant budgets or routing policies. Loader should only expose: get_layer_stats(model_id, layer_ids) -> {access_rate, hotness, est_size}.
Tony: If we add cold_start_score calc to the coordinator, we avoid changing many loaders. But coordinator needs good estimates for recompute_penalty which depends on runtime and hw.
Sara M.: Exactly. Proposal: two options — A) coordinator-side scoring: loaders return raw stats; coordinator computes score using a model-specific profile. B) loader-side scoring: loader returns precomputed layer_score and a small provenance blob.
warmup-bot: Reminder: please keep warmup RPCs under 1ms p50 to avoid SLO regressions. :warning:
Liam: Option A keeps compatibility but increases network chatter because coordinator may ask for per-layer stats for many layers. Option B reduces chatter but requires loader upgrades.
Meera: Can we hybridize? Loaders return coarse-grain summaries (per-chunk) + on-demand detail for candidate layers. So coordinator asks for summaries, then requests detailed stats for top-N candidates.
Dmitri: That seems like a good middle ground. Need to define the proto surface. Sketch: 
```proto
svc WarmupService {
  rpc SummarizeLayers(SummarizeRequest) returns (SummarizeResponse);
  rpc LayerDetail(LayerDetailRequest) returns (LayerDetailResponse);
}
message SummarizeRequest { string model_id = 1; repeated uint32 layer_ids = 2; }
message SummarizeResponse { repeated LayerSummary summaries = 1; }
message LayerSummary { uint32 layer_id = 1; float est_access_rate = 2; uint64 est_size = 3; }
```
Meera: + add an optional provenance field and a schema version header so coordinator can fallback when it sees an older loader.
Tony: How do we account for quantized variants? The est_size differs and recompute_penalty may change if we have fused kernels.
Sara M.: We'll include variant metadata in the summary: quantized_tag, kernel_hint. Coordinator scoring function will accept variant multipliers.
Liam: Another operational point: telemetry. We must ensure the summaries are sampled and aggregated to avoid hitting control-plane rate limits. Suggest sampling 1-5% by default and ramp for canaries.
Dmitri: Also propose an emergency fallback policy: if coordinator can't get any detail within timeout, fall back to simple heuristics: highest-parameter layers first + prefix caching for KV-heavy layers. Log a metric for visibility.
Meera: Sounds good. Who wants to drive a short RFC PR with the proto and the coordinator scoring pseudo-code? Keep it small — loaders can be opt-in.
Sara M.: I can start the PR tomorrow with the proto draft and a small simulation of score sensitivity. Will include examples and unit test ideas.
Tony: Helpful — I'll review and add the variant multipliers table.
Liam: I'll do a quick perf probe to measure SummarizeLayers p50/p95 on staging GPUs.
Dmitri: I'll wire the fallback metrics and add a dashboard widget.
warmup-bot: Noted. New task created: WARMUP-2123 (layer-priority-summarize-rfc).
Sara M.: Thanks everyone. Quick aside: avoid the term "prefetch bidding" in the PR — too marketing-y. Keep it technical. :smile:
Meera: :thumbsup:
Tony: :rocket:
